title: Immaculate Naam Itself, Ever-fresh, Comes To Abide
summary: Restlessness is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:; the Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind
lifeApplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:; the Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: Siree Raag, Third Mehla:; the Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind
evidence.turn: Restlessness steadies when he Himself unites us in Union; Nanak is absorbed in the Shabad.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
